project: Industrial Conveyor Belt Joint Rupture & Damage Monitoring System
policy: INDUSTRIAL DATA, TESTING & ML TRAINING POLICY

RESEARCH.description: Externally sourced peer-reviewed or empirical laboratory experimental datasets.

SIMULATION.description: Synthetic telemetry and fault signals generated for DSP pipeline, HMI, and software validation.

FIELD_HARDWARE.description: Real sensor telemetry collected from ESP32 DAQ on physical conveyor machinery.
FIELD_HARDWARE.provenance_rule: Must be flagged with data_source = 'field' or 'hardware'. Never mixed with synthetic data.

SOFTWARE_TEST.description: Unit and integration test fixtures, deterministic signals, and mock payloads.
SOFTWARE_TEST.provenance_rule: Strictly scoped to unit testing, never used for training or scientific claims.
